claim_summary: The Pythagorean-leg conflict graphs on the first-prime boxes have independence numbers 1, 4, 21, 144 for N=1,2,3,4, and are bipartite exactly when \(N\le4\).
integrity: Claims rest on a parity argument, an explicit known Euler-brick witness, and finite independent-set and disjoint-edge certificates checked exhaustively by the bundled standard-library verifier; no external independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact \(f(N)\) calculation is confined to \(N\le4\); nonbipartiteness for \(N\ge5\) does not determine \(f(N)\) in that range. Euler brick 240,252,275 is classical and not claimed new. Unindexed equivalent finite data remain possible.
title: Sharp Pythagorean independence in the first prime-power boxes
